text_block_list.text:
Without warning, several prominent
Umamusume
from previous generations
come out of hiatus and
rejoin the fierce
competition on the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The dawning of the Ultimate Era sets
Eishin Flash
on edge, and she starts
making blunders during
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш is positive that, at this rate,
she won't
be able to keep the promise
she made to her
parents to win every
race leading up to the
autumn Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Rather than face the fiery competition in
G1
races, she replaces them with G2
and G3 races,
where she is nearly
guaranteed to win by default.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Fearing that Эйсин Флэш is setting
herself up for
failure, I seek Smart
Falcon for advice on how to
get through
to her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
